## Fixes

- **Log filters look right in dark mode.** The server and person pickers opened as a white list with unreadable text. In Vencord they are now Discord's own dropdowns, and you can type to find a server or a person. In BetterDiscord the list follows the dark theme.

Everything from [v1.14.0](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/releases/tag/v1.14.0) is included.

## Update

Vencord: click the new-version notification on Windows or macOS, or download `FriendsInVoice-v1.14.1.zip` and run `install.bat` on Windows or `install.command` / `bash install.sh` on macOS. If you use two Discords, open your main account first after updating.

BetterDiscord: replace your plugin file with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release.

## Verification

Vencord TypeScript check and lint passed, plus all 30 plugin tests and all 21 BetterDiscord port tests.
